text:
Customer - AcmeCorp: Hi, after we rotated our service connector this morning our engineers can't access the Project console — getting 403 on every project switch. This broke our deploy pipeline. Request id from response: req_0a9f3b2c. Can someone help?

Alex R: Sorry about that — we're looking. Can you paste the full 403 response body (if available) and an example curl you ran? Also which org/project id?

support-bot: New support ticket created: #SUP-11432 — assigned to Alex R.

Customer - AcmeCorp: Response body is small: `{
  "error": "permission_denied",
  "message": "Request denied (403)",
  "request_id": "req_0a9f3b2c"
}`. Example curl we ran: `curl -H \"Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN\" \"https://console.redwood.ai/orgs/orga-44/projects/proj-12\"` — token is the service principal token issued to our connector.

Maria G: Quick check — after connector rotation did you re-link the connector in the console or perform a full SCIM resync? If the underlying service principal ID changed the role bindings can become orphaned.

Customer - AcmeCorp: We rotated via our IdP — we thought SCIM would pick it up automatically. We didn't manually re-link.

Jordan L: Could be that the connector rotation created a new service identity (svc-xxxxx) and the old principal id used in role bindings no longer exists. That would result in 403s on console actions even if tokens look valid.

Samir P (eng-oncall): Can you share the decoded JWT (headers + payload) from one of the failing tokens (omit sensitive fields) so we can see principal_id / sub / scopes? If not, paste the `x-request-id` + 5-10 minute window and we'll grep logs.

Customer - AcmeCorp: Pasting payload (sanitized): `{ "sub": "svc-98765", "iss": "https://idp.acme/", "scope": "console:read console:write" }`. The old bindings referenced `svc-12345`. Request id above is correct, window 09:12-09:20 UTC.

Alex R: Thanks. I can confirm from logs we see successful token validation for `svc-98765` but we have bindings only for `svc-12345` -> hence the 403. Temporary workaround: a project admin (org owner) can rebind the new principal to the project role via the admin API. Example command: 

```
curl -X POST "https://api.redwood.ai/v1/orgs/ORG-44/projects/PROJ-12/role-bindings" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer <ORG_OWNER_TOKEN>" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"principal_id":"svc-98765","role":"project.admin"}'
```
This will re-grant the service connector the expected project role until we fix the upstream mapping.

Customer - AcmeCorp: That worked — we can access the console again. Thanks.

Maria G: We'll escalate to infra team to run a full connector->binding reconciliation and add a guard for connector rotations that invalidates stale bindings.

eng-oncall: Scheduled a resync job for org ORG-44. We also flagged a bug: when connector rotation creates a new principal id we currently do not auto-migrate role-bindings for SCIM-based connectors. Patch planned for next deploy window.

Samir P (eng-oncall): Root cause summary for the ticket: connector rotation changed service principal id; role-bindings referenced old id; SCIM/connector resync didn't auto-migrate bindings. Immediate mitigation: rebind new principal (done). Long-term: add migration step in connector rotation flow + post-rotation full binding sync.

Customer - AcmeCorp: Appreciate the quick help. Please keep us posted on the patch timeline — this touches multiple projects for us.

Alex R: Will follow up — patch ETA in next 48 hours, we'll post here and update SUP-11432. For next-steps: 1) leave temporary binding in place, 2) we'll run reconciliation and remove orphaned old principals, 3) customer to confirm no further 403s after resync.

support-bot: Ticket SUP-11432 updated: status -> pending-eng.

Customer - AcmeCorp: Confirmed: no further 403s. Thanks :white_check_mark: 

Samir P (eng-oncall): Postmortem note to add to ticket: include instructions for customers to re-link connectors after IdP-driven rotations or run manual binding migration. Also adding docs link: https://docs.redwood.ai/identity/service-connectors#rotation-migration

Alex R: Closing initial support thread here — will keep SUP-11432 open until patch ships. :thumbsup:
